hero.title: The new standard in LED efficiency.
hero.subtitle: Patented technology. Over 275 lumens per watt. Universal compatibility.

offer.title: A platform technology for the lighting industry.
offer.body: Almenara develops a patented LED platform that supplies original equipment manufacturers, architectural lighting partners, and infrastructure operators. The technology integrates into new luminaires and retrofits existing fixtures — delivering more than 275 lumens per watt and over 50 % energy reduction against the current industry standard.

efficiency.title: Industry-leading efficiency
efficiency.body: More than 275 lm/W. Twice the efficacy of the typical state-of-the-art LED module in commercial deployment.

patent.title: Defensible patent position
patent.body: A worldwide patent portfolio protecting the underlying optical and thermal architecture.

universal.title: Universal compatibility
universal.body: Retrofit-ready. Compatible with any LED luminaire on the market. No specification rework required.

european.title: Engineered in Madrid
european.body: European design, European certification, European supply chain. Built for institutional procurement.

applications.title: Where it is installed.
applications.body: From hospitality and architectural projects to industrial and public infrastructure. The technology adapts to any spectrum, any form factor, any scale.

awards.title: Recognised by.
awards.ibm: National Prize for Energy Saving — IBM offices retrofit, Mexico City

cta.title: Become a partner.
cta.body: For OEMs, lighting designers, integrators and infrastructure operators evaluating the next generation of LED.
